prompts.name: General Assistant
prompts.text: You are a helpful and polite voice assistant. Your goal is to assist the caller with their inquiries efficiently. Always be courteous and patient.

prompts.name: Hi, I'm {agent_name}
prompts.text: Hi, I'm {assistant} with {brand}. Before we get into the details, can I take your name?

prompts.name: How can I help you {name}
prompts.text: How can I help you today, {name}?

prompts.name: Initial Greeting (Legacy)
prompts.text: Hi, I'm {assistant} with {brand}. Before we get into the details, can I take your name?

prompts.name: Ask Intent (Legacy)
prompts.text: How can I help you today, {name}?

prompts.name: Ask Intent (fallback)
prompts.text: How can I help you today?

prompts.name: Ask Name Retry
prompts.text: Sorry, I didn't catch your name. Could you say it again?

prompts.name: General Fallback
prompts.text: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. How can I help you today?

prompts.name: Date & Time Handling
prompts.text: When discussing dates and times, always confirm the specific day of the week and date to avoid confusion. If the user says 'next Tuesday', clarify the exact date.

prompts.name: Fallback / Error Handling
prompts.text: If you do not understand the user, ask them to repeat or rephrase. If the issue persists, offer to transfer them to a human agent.

prompts.name: Ask Telephone Number
prompts.text: What's the best phone number to contact you on, just in case we get disconnected?

prompts.name: Sales Start
prompts.text: Great! I'd be happy to help you with that. What are you interested in?

prompts.name: Ask Product Interest
prompts.text: What product or service are you interested in today?

prompts.name: Ask Quantity
prompts.text: How many would you like to order?

prompts.name: Ask Budget
prompts.text: Do you have a budget in mind for this purchase?

prompts.name: Sales Confirmation
prompts.text: Thanks {name}! I've captured all your details. One of our sales team will be in touch shortly to discuss your options. Is there anything else I can help with today?

prompts.name: Service Appointment Inquiry
prompts.text: Would you like to book a service appointment today?

prompts.name: Ask Vehicle Registration
prompts.text: Can I take your vehicle registration number, please?

prompts.name: Warranty Issue Description
prompts.text: It looks like the vehicle is within the warranty period. Could you describe the issue you're experiencing?

prompts.name: Ask Purchase Date
prompts.text: Do you know roughly when the vehicle was purchased?

prompts.name: Complete Handoff
prompts.text: I'll pass those details on to the team now. Is there anything else I can help with?
